newsitem.title: USA: KANSAS FED CATTLE TRADE VERY SLOW AT $64 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: KANSAS FED CATTLE TRADE VERY SLOW AT $64 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow, with a few sales slaughter steers and heifers steady to firm, USDA said. Inquiry was moderate and demand light.

Sales were confirmed on 1,000 slaughter steers and 700 slaughter heifers Tuesday. For the week to date 18,100 head confirmed including 13,700 head previously contracted or formulated cattle. Confirmed - 1700
Slaughter Steers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1100 lbs 64.00, pen 1250 lb cutting bulls 64.00. Dressed Basis - Select and Choice 2-3 1275 lbs 102.00 hot weights, delivered.
Slaughter Heifers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1125 lbs 64.00; pen mixed Commercial to Choice 1200 lb heifers and heiferettes 64.00. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
